name: fp-minify
description: Comment-concision mode. Shapes the code the model writes so comments earn their place (a non-obvious why, or meaning a name can't hold: config, units, constraints) and stay short. Hard one-line cap on inline comments, plus a density bar, so most functions carry none. Measurements, rejected alternatives, and the debugging story go to the commit. API docstrings are exempt. Sets a prior at the task edge, never steers mid-solve. Modes: off, new, tidy (default). Plus /fp-minify:strip for deliberate bulk de-commenting.
